  "sql": "WITH _base AS (\n  SELECT\n    customers__regions.id AS \"orders.customers.regions.id\",\n    customers__regions.name AS \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    COUNT(*) AS \"orders.count_all\",\n    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS \"orders.amt\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers\n    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id\n  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions\n    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id\n  WHERE\n    NOT customers.id IS NULL\n  GROUP BY\n    customers__regions.id,\n    customers__regions.name\n), _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum AS (\n  SELECT\n    customers__regions.id AS \"orders.customers.regions.id\",\n    customers__regions.name AS \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    SUM(orders.amount - customers.discount) AS \"orders.net\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers\n    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id\n  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions\n    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id\n  WHERE\n    NOT customers.id IS NULL\n  GROUP BY\n    customers__regions.id,\n    customers__regions.name\n)\nSELECT\n  _base.\"orders.customers.regions.id\",\n  _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n  _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum.\"orders.net\",\n  _base.\"orders.count_all\",\n  _base.\"orders.amt\"\nFROM _base\nLEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum\n  ON _base.\"orders.customers.regions.id\" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum.\"orders.customers.regions.id\"\n  AND _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum.\"orders.customers.regions.name\"\nORDER BY\n  _base.\"orders.customers.regions.id\" ASC,\n  _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\" ASC\nLIMIT 101"
}

args.message: Here is each region's total of order amount minus the ordering customer's discount: North 104835.76, South 99462.90, East 64730.70 and West 47717.79. The 10 orders whose customer has no known region form their own group (null), totalling 627.83. Orders with no matching customer are left out. No customer with orders had a missing discount, so every order is counted. The table has the exact, unrounded values.
